## Code Review

This pull request enhances security for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) operations by preventing caller-supplied user ID injection in `api/rag/ask.js` and asserting this sanitization in tests. It also introduces a database migration to restrict access to legacy RAG search logs (`public.rag_search_logs`) by enabling row-level security (RLS), revoking all privileges from public and Data API roles, and securing related database functions. Comprehensive tests have been added to verify these security boundaries. There are no review comments, so no feedback is provided.
